narrative.details:
I'm working on getting some supplies together for our outpost near the beach to the east--Tok'kar does what he can, but between shifts of guard duty and cooking for his soldiers there's not much time left in the day.

They do enjoy cooking up some sawtooth meat when they can, but I haven't had time to get them another shipment. Would you mind helping them out?

The young sawtooths aren't as tasty as the older ones, so stay clear of those; give them a year or two to get to full size.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Unprepared Sawtooth Flanks to Tok'Kar in Swamp of Sorrows.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah! Wonderful. Fresh meat for the fire tonight. Thank you, adventurer.

You've helped make the coming nights more tolerable. The fire burns bright, and our stomachs will be full.

Its a pleasant surprise to have you bring us a shipment; Dar's not the most attractive orc anyone's laid eyes upon, but at least his attitude reeks far less than his smell.
narrative.requestItemsText: Lok'tar, Champion. Traveling through the swamps isn't a risk taken lightly. You're brave to test your mettle here.
